title: Malformed or closed-shape plans never activate
intended_use: An X-Verse engineer submits a malformed or closed-shape-violating activation plan and expects it to be rejected before any activation with a stable code and no decoded value.
expected: Declared plan-schema/digest mutations are flagged and no malformed plan decodes.
environment: candidate checkout, offline; the C++ malformed-plan matrix and the T019 contract provide the primary unit evidence.
